note: Prices, durations and descriptions are examples for the demo and are to be confirmed with the salon.

capelli.label: Hair
capelli.lead: From the classic cut to a skin fade.

taglio-uomo.name: Men's haircut
taglio-uomo.desc: You talk shape and length with the barber, then it's clippers and scissors where needed. Edges finished and a final style: you walk out ready.
steps: Choose shape and length with the barber.

skin-fade.name: Skin fade
skin-fade.desc: The fade that drops all the way to the skin: smooth and gradual, no harsh lines. You decide the length on top together. It looks great with a defined beard.
steps: Decide the height of the fade and the length on top.
Skin fade with clippers and razor.

taglio-e-styling.name: Haircut & styling
taglio-e-styling.desc: The full haircut with extra time for styling: drying, product and a finish designed around how you wear your hair every day, so you know how to redo it at home.
steps: Drying and styling with the right products.

taglio-bambino.name: Kids' haircut
taglio-bambino.desc: A quick, stress-free haircut for children up to 12, with the same care we give adults.
steps: Pick the cut together with mum or dad.
A final tidy and off they go.

regolazione-barba.name: Beard trim
regolazione-barba.desc: To keep the beard tidy between treatments: shape, length and the lines on cheeks and neck.
steps: Sharp lines on cheeks and neck.

barba-panno-caldo-e-lama.name: Hot towel beard & blade finish
barba-panno-caldo-e-lama.desc: A hot towel to soften, shaping, a blade finish and an oil to end. The most complete beard treatment.
steps: Hot towel to open and soften.

rasatura-tradizionale.name: Traditional shave
rasatura-tradizionale.desc: The old-school shave: lather, hot towel and a straight razor for a smooth result, with moisturised skin at the end.

taglio-e-barba.name: Haircut & beard
taglio-e-barba.desc: Haircut and beard in the same sitting, with a single appointment: hair and beard planned together for a cohesive look.

platino-e-taglio.name: Platinum & cut
platino-e-taglio.desc: Full bleach for platinum hair and a cut that shows it off. It starts with a consultation: time and cost depend on your starting hair.
